Brief received

Thank you — your cake brief is in

We've got your details, and a confirmation is on its way to your inbox. Your brief has been passed to My Event Match so relevant cake makers can review it.

  1. 1We review and matchWe use your location, date and style to identify cake makers who genuinely suit your brief.
  2. 2Makers respond to youYou'll start hearing back with approaches, availability and pricing — usually within one to two business days.
  3. 3You compare and chooseReview the responses side by side and book directly with the maker who feels right. No obligation either way.
Browse cake inspiration Read the budget guide

Nifty setup: this is the redirect target for every lead form on the site. Add the conversion tag (GA4 / Google Ads / Meta) to this page only, so one submission is counted once.
